items.title: Ran Blake interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 16, 2021
items.q: I think so but sometimes I mean Beethoven was very deliberate on the Pastoral Symphony.

ctx.x: your music programmatic in a sense that you were inspired by something and you are trying to capture it in your music? In your piano music?

I think so but sometimes I mean Beethoven was very deliberate on the Pastoral Symphony. I know there’ve been many pieces that describe a character. I think instead of trying to capture it though, it captures me.
And what do you expect or hope that your listener derives from the music?
